method: Five sequential 20-second tests in Codex in-app Chromium on development Mac, fixed medium tier, actual visible DOM measurements. Worker clock is quantized to 0.1 ms; zero means below timer resolution. No whole-process/browser memory access. This Mac has not been identified as the weakest team laptop.
hardware_class: Development Mac, macOS 27.0.1 arm64; CPU/RAM unavailable to sandbox
manual_tactical_fallback: 200-contact scene replaced by detected-contact 2D radar; 2D paint FPS not measured
